<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a halide (alkyl or aryl) and form a primary, secondary, or tertiary amine, which corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a nucleophilic amine attacks a carbon bearing a leaving halide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines", "secondary amines", "tertiary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
